g.text: PREVIEW | Screenshot-rounded values; replace with verified server export before submission.
Dark / medium / light blue: q < 0.001 / 0.01 / 0.05; grey: q ≥ 0.05; tan: not estimable.
S: strict; P: protocol sample; A: + medication; Q: quadratic; C: covariate interactions; U: all-seven sample.
Retention requires estimability, same interaction sign and qAll84 < 0.05. Cohorts overlap.
